name: TEN Revival
description: Local lab revival of the Total Entertainment Network: reverse-engineer the Win98 TEN client protocol and reimplement enough auth/lobby/game services so original clients can connect. Duke Nukem 3D multiplayer is end-to-end proven; focus is Dark Sun Online launch.

launchProfile.statusCommand: check() { if ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":$2 "; then echo "$1 up"; else echo "$1 down"; fi; }; check monitor 7504; check echo 7; check ftp 21; check web 8010
